{{Quote|Get a message to the fleet! We have to warn&mdash;|O'Niner's final words|audio=WeHaveToWarn-Rookies.flac|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
'''O'Niner''', designated '''CT-19-7409''', was the name assumed by a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he participated in the war's [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] as well as the [[Battle of the Celestial Wake]], and was later stationed at a [[Rishi Station/Legends|listening post]] in the [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]] that served as a lookout for impending [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] attacks on nearby [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. When the station came under [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|attack]] by Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], O'Niner ordered for a message to be sent to warn the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|fleet]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]], however, were [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] the station's signal, and O'Niner was [[Death/Legends|killed]] defending the post.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Even though you're all new here, I shouldn't have to remind you that this quadrant is key to the Outer Rim.|O'Niner, addressing his troops at Rishi Station|audio=KeyToTheOuterRim-Rookies.flac|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
[[File:ONinerContactsCT327-Rookies.png|thumb|left|225px|O'Niner on Rishi Station]]
The [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] CT-19-7409, who adopted the nickname O'Niner, was [[Cloning/Legends|born]] and raised on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] of the war on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], as well as the [[Battle of the Celestial Wake]],<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> and he was later assigned to [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]], a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Rishi moon|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. The outpost acted as an outer defense against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], as well as a lookout post to warn nearby [[Star system/Legends|systems]] of attacking Confederate forces. O'Niner commanded the other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] stationed there, most of whom were "[[Shiny/Legends|shinies]]"&mdash;new and inexperienced troopers whose [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] was unscathed and shiny.<ref name="Rookies" />

During the war's first year,<ref name="Date" /> a group of Confederate [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|attacked]] the station, taking the clones by surprise. O'Niner ordered for a message to be dispatched to the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] to warn them of the advancing Confederate forces, but the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] their signal, preventing any messages from being transmitted. O'Niner was quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by enemy [[Laser/Legends|fire]], and the droids took the station, leaving only four [[Troop/Legends|troopers]]&mdash;[[Fives/Legends|Fives]], [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]], and [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]]&mdash;alive to warn the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the impending Confederate attack. With the help of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], who were coming to inspect the listening post, the clones managed to warn the fleet, and the Confederate attack was prevented.<ref name="Rookies" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You may not realize it yet Fives, but you landed on the most boring post in the Outer Rim.''"<br />"''And one of the most important.|Hevy and O'Niner|audio=MostBoringPost-Rookies.flac|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
[[File:ONiner-TCW.png|thumb|right|180px|O'Niner was a dedicated and no-nonsense leader.]]
Sergeant O'Niner was completely loyal to the Republic, and his first concern was for its safety and that of the other clones, especially those back on Kamino. He also understood the importance of the Rishi outpost, even though many of the other troopers believed that it lacked action and excitement.<ref name="Rookies" /> His body was scarred from battles that he had served in during the war,<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> and his brow even became furrowed from the stress of war. O'Niner stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] (6 [[Foot/Legends|ft]]) tall<ref name="TCWCE" /> and had tan skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] as well as black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], which was greying at the time of his death.<ref name="Rookies" /> 

==Skills and abilities==
The sergeant was trained in combat, recon, military tactics and leadership.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Equipment==
On the Rishi moon, O'Niner wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]<ref name="Rookies" /> which was dirty and damaged from many battles.<ref name="TCWCE" /> In battle, the clone used a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]]<ref name="Rookies" /> and a [[DC-15s side arm blaster|DC-15 blaster pistol]].<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Behind the scenes==
O'Niner made his only appearance in "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," the fifth episode in [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]], which first aired on [[October 24]], [[2008]]. He was voiced in the episode by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all of the clone troopers in the television series.<ref name="Rookies Episode Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref> O'Niner's clone designation of CT-19-7409 was revealed in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles'']] sourcebook.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" />
